topic.source_contract: Radon-potential mapping, exact-address reports, measurement, building protection, commissioning and workplace risk evidence

facts.map: indicative map shows radon potential by area
facts.guard: area mapping is not an exact property measurement

facts.address: address search and measurement are distinct steps
facts.guard: map class is not annual-average concentration

facts.guidance: UKHSA radon guidance and publications collection
facts.guard: public-health guidance is not building-control approval

facts.building: ground contaminants and protective construction within Approved Document C
facts.guard: guidance use is not compliance proof

facts.workplace: radon must be considered in workplace risk assessment in relevant circumstances
facts.guard: map status is not workplace measurement

scope_guards: An indicative radon map is not treated as an exact property result.
An address report is not treated as a measured annual-average concentration.
A low area probability is not treated as proof of zero radon.
A protective design is not treated as installed and commissioned protection.
Approved Document C guidance is not treated as automatic compliance.
Domestic and workplace duties are not conflated.
Basements and underground spaces are not screened out by surface mapping.
No score or promotion is written without exact address status, measurement, design, installation, commissioning and follow-up evidence.
